pinTitle: Will Preschool Help My 3-Year-Old's Aggression After a New Baby? | Evidence-Based Parenting
pinDescription: If your 3-year-old has become more aggressive since a new sibling arrived, you're not alone. Learn what the research says about typical adjustment behaviors, whether preschool can help, and practical strategies grounded in child development science.
